description: This file defines the EmpEmergencyContactService class, which provides various methods to manage and access employee emergency contact information within the OrangeHRM system. It interacts with the data access object (DAO) EmpEmergencyContactDao to fetch, save, delete, and search emergency contact records for employees.

classes.name: EmpEmergencyContactService
classes.description: Service class that provides methods to manage employee emergency contact data, acting as an intermediary between controllers and the data access layer.

methods.name: getEmpEmergencyContactDao
methods.description: Lazy loader for the EmpEmergencyContactDao instance, instantiates if not already set.

methods.name: setEmpEmergencyContactDao
methods.description: Setter to inject a specific EmpEmergencyContactDao instance, useful for testing or custom DAOs.

methods.name: getEmployeeEmergencyContact
methods.description: Retrieves a specific emergency contact for an employee based on employee number and sequence number.

methods.name: getEmployeeEmergencyContactList
methods.description: Fetches a list of all emergency contacts for a given employee.

methods.name: saveEmpEmergencyContact
methods.description: Saves or updates an employee emergency contact record.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeEmergencyContacts
methods.description: Deletes specified emergency contact entries for an employee, or all if sequence numbers are empty.

methods.name: searchEmployeeEmergencyContacts
methods.description: Searches for employee emergency contacts based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeEmergencyContactsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of emergency contacts matching search filters.
